profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
profile.summary: I am a graduate of the University of Utah with an Honors Bachelor of Science degree in computer science with a minor in ethnic studies. I enjoy learning new things. This is why I am a software developer. I have experience with .NET Framework, C#, Java, Springboot, HTML, SQL, Firebase, HTML, JavaScript, mobile app development, web development, and various other technologies and software practices. I also understand that the software development process is a team effort. Therefore, I enjoy collaborating with engineers and learning from them. I believe as a collective we can learn from one another.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant Math Center
positions.description:
• Graded Calculus I-III assignments, quizzes, and exams. In addition to grading, my responsibilities involved giving constructive feedback. 

• Tutored courses from Calculus III and below. Challenging students to think critically and understand topics at a deeper level. 

• On occasions, help students with their programming assignments by helping them understand the math and logic involved within their program.

company.name: University of Utah College of Science

positions.title: Software Engineer Analyst
positions.description:
• I worked with the Consumer Wealth Management(CWM) engineering team.

• The project I worked on was to help the team develop a web service so that the clients can manage their financial assets and account information.

• My role was to integrate WebSockets into their service and change the existing architecture into a pub/sub model.

positions.title: Parking Attendant
positions.description:
• Instruct people on where to park and where their events are.

• Making sure that the guests paid for parking before entering the lot.

• Made sure that the by the end of the daily deposit were balanced.

positions.title: Banquet Server
positions.description:
• Helping serve any number of guests as little as 10 to 1000plus depending on the event. 

• Led a team of servers and instructed them on how to set up tables for events, serve our clients, and how to take special orders.

• Manage service around the schedule of the event. Such as scheduling when meals should be served and when the after meals have been served.

positions.title: Computer Science Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Graded students’ assignments, giving them feedback on what good coding standards should be. 

• Guide lab sessions and help students develop their programming skills by forcing them to think critically. 

• Help students debug their own code and help them gain a deeper understanding of their program.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Engineering Practices · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Software · Visual Studio · C#
